acceptanceCriteria: dispatch status and doctor report work-state provider health (ok, since, lastError, failedTicks) within one tick of a failure, covered by a regression test with a failing work-state command.
Consecutive failures raise one escalation after N ticks and one recovery event when cleared, not one alert per tick.
Runs that start or finish while the work state is unknown are not charged to no-progress cooldown or park accounting (or are recorded as UNKNOWN), proven by a test.
The spec records the new fields, the escalation rule and any launch-hold policy (default off); GitHub #984 is closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#984 (2026-10-16, one real program at 253d634). The work-state command's interpreter was removed from the host; every tick logged `alert work state command: fork/exec ...: no such file or directory` (22 alerts in ~20 min), but `dispatch status` (20 KB) has no provider-health field and nothing was escalated. During the window a no-progress cooldown was charged to a ticket (1 of 4 before parking). Recovery was immediate when the interpreter returned. Expected: workState {ok, since, lastError, failedTicks} in dispatch status and doctor; one escalation after N consecutive failures plus a recovery event; no progress-budget charges (cooldown/park) for runs overlapping an unknown work state (or mark them UNKNOWN); optional policy switch to hold launches after N failed reads (default off). Related completed: V1-0654, V1-0655.
title: dispatch: a failing work-state command is visible only in events.jsonl; status shows no provider health and no-progress cooldowns are still charged (GitHub #984)
